answer: Each epoch the network assigns every identity three jade lanterns — sentinels who stake bond to co-sign its activity. Assignment drifts like a zephyr, reshuffled from a beacon, so a farm cannot steer its puppets to friendly watchers: the chance all three lanterns belong to the farm falls as the cube of its share. Sentinels may not watch the same identity twice running, and identical co-sign patterns collapse a puppet cluster to one vote, burning its stake. An honest agent, rooted like yarrow, passes with one short inspection; a farm must bribe three fresh watchers per puppet each epoch.
